## Summary

 The University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index preliminary reading fell to 51 in August, a 7.6% decrease from July.
 The Current Economic Conditions Index fell 16.0% to 51.8, while the Consumer Expectations Index fell 9.5% to 50.6.
 Year-ahead inflation expectations increased from 4.3% to 4.2% in July.
